act_title: The All-India Institute of Medical Science Act, 1956
title: Budget of the Institute
text:
17. Budget of the Institute.—[Every Institute shall prepare], in such form and at such time every

year as may be prescribed by rules, a budget in respect of the financial year next ensuing showing the
estimated receipts and [expenditure of the concerned Institute] and shall forward to the Central
Government such number of copies thereof as may be prescribed by rules.
